profile.summary: Ninyo & Moore is a geotechnical and environmental engineering firm founded in San Diego in 1986. It provides geotechnical engineering, environmental services, construction materials testing, inspection services and industrial hygiene. It was acquired by SOCOTEC in 2025 and is now part of the SOCOTEC US brand.

sources.title: SOCOTEC acquires Ninyo & Moore, doubling its size in the United States

review.notes: The SOCOTEC location page confirms the Alameda office at 1301 Marina Village Pkwy was formerly operated by Ninyo & Moore, and the press release confirms the 2025 acquisition, San Diego HQ, 1986 founding and the listed services, which fit OUSD's geotechnical, materials-testing and hazardous-soil contracts. The summary is neutral and supported.
